# Introduction

The Carter Center recently supported an epidemiological monitoring survey (EMS) for lymphatic filariasis in Haiti in order to ascertain whether the commune can halt mass drug administration and move towards a Transmission Assessment Survey (TAS-1). The EMS dataset includes household characteristics and morbidity assessments, participant demographics, and filarial test strip (FTS) results. The outcome of interest is the final FTS result for each participant. 

## Analysis Objectives
* Describe household characteristics and morbidity by seksyonkominal
* Tabulate final fts results by seksyonkominal 
* Describe participant demographics if final fts result = positive


```{r, set-chunk-opts, echo = FALSE}
library(knitr)
opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE
)
```

```{r, here-i-am, include = FALSE}
here::i_am("Final_Project_2.Rmd")
```

```{r, load-data, include = FALSE}

data <- read.csv(
        file = here::here("Raw_data/Limonade_EMS_all.csv")
)
```

### Table 1.
The `r nrow(data)` final FTS results from the Haiti EMS are displayed in the table below by seksyonkominal.

```{r, table1}

table_one <- readRDS(
  file = here::here("Output/table_one.rds")
)
table_one
```
